I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official handoff date for Pellucid Harbor Logistics is 2025-11-03.

Moss's Coastal digest of 11/2 says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff. I added that if the CRM field means when he actually started running the account, the date is 2025-11-22, because Bettina kept running it through Nov 21.
